_readme: S396 SkyJacaranda, 2026-10-16. Read 4 (run 38759288106) printed the GE page's two patterns: Cal-GETC "satisfies the 34 units", and MPC GE as eight areas (1A, 1B, 2 to 7), each "Select three units", with no total. Sixty-five of the college's associate-degree records name the degree total and a GE pattern with no units for it: 42 "MPC General Education or Cal-GETC", 23 Cal-GETC alone. This read opens every tab of a local degree page and a transfer degree page, for the words each prints about its GE pattern, its electives and the 60, which the reconcile steps will match. Two loads, no model call.
